# Fixes v0.20.6 must carry. Format: module | commit | note
#
#   module  = "conduit" for this repository, or a Go module path resolved in go.mod
#   commit  = SHA of at least 7 hex digits; must be an ancestor of the module's
#             pinned version (or of HEAD for "conduit")
#   note    = short description. release_notes_check.py requires every note (or
#             the commit's 7-character prefix) to appear in the `## Fixed`
#             section of docs/releases/v0.20.6.md, so keep it verbatim.
#
# A patch release (Z > 0) must have at least one entry, and at least one entry
# that is NEW since v0.20.5 (its commit is not already in that tag). A list of
# old commits does not pass. Verify before tagging with:
#     make release-check TAG=v0.20.6

# Engine — API exposure (localhost default, token off-loopback, origin/host/UI

conduit | 19f8c952 | bind the API to localhost by default and require a token off-loopback

# Engine — misuse via the API (env.allow, file/JS directory allowlists, plugin
# env minimal):
conduit | 919185b9 | restrict plugin environment and file and JavaScript access to allowlists

conduit | 919185b9 | guard outbound HTTP at dial time against the egress allowlist

# Engine — log connector metadata-only:

# Engine — file source complete-lines follower and fail-loud rotation:

# Engine — default-DLQ refusal (pipeline.dlq_not_recoverable):
conduit | 919185b9 | refuse to start a pipeline with no recoverable DLQ

conduit | 213daec5 | bump the Go toolchain to 1.26.10 for GO-2026-6809
